create.name: Natasja Pelgrom
create.bio:
Natasja Pelgrom is a Dutch guide in ceremonial and entheogenic work who spent her twenties and early thirties running hospitality and cultural ventures in Amsterdam. Alongside that career she had studied philosophy, meditation, Zen, vision quests and indigenous and pagan traditions since her teens, and in 2012 she chose to bring that private path into her working life. Her training also includes client-centred coaching, Somatic Experiencing, depth psychology and transpersonal practice.

Her retreat company, Awaken the Medicine Within (started 2017), runs small legal retreats with psilocybin truffles and 5-MeO-DMT in the Netherlands and Portugal, with time given to preparation and integration before and after ceremony. She has held space in more than a thousand ceremonies. Her more recent work is aimed at people who guide others: Guardians of Transformation, an eight-day practicum for facilitators, along with one-to-one mentorship, professional supervision and online masterclasses taught under her Presence-Centered Leadership approach. She also founded the Eudaimonia Institute, an online learning platform, and the Stewards of the Sacred virtual conference, and she hosts The Awaken Podcast, where she talks with scientists, ritual holders and teachers about spirituality and altered states.

courses.title: Five-Day Psilocybin Truffle Immersive
courses.description: A small-group residential retreat in the Netherlands with two truffle ceremonies, held within the Dutch legal framework. The days around the ceremonies are given to preparation, reflection and integration, with themes of purpose, creativity and the spiritual path.

courses.title: Guardians of Transformation
courses.description: An eight-day residential practicum in Portugal for facilitators, coaches and others who hold space for people in expanded states. Limited to eight places per cohort, it combines direct experience, supervision and peer reflection, with two cohorts planned for 2027.

courses.title: Private Retreat (Psychedelic Odyssey)
courses.description: A tailored private retreat in the Netherlands for one person or a small group who know each other, working with psilocybin truffles and/or 5-MeO-DMT. Planned around the participant's own intentions, with discretion for people in public roles.

courses.title: One-on-One Mentorship
courses.description: A nine-month mentoring programme for leaders, facilitators and practitioners whose work is growing. It looks at purpose, ethics and the tension between devotion and business.

courses.title: Professional Supervision for Practitioners
courses.description: Supervision sessions for facilitators and therapists already working with psychedelic preparation, ceremonies or integration. Sessions offer reflection on cases, boundaries and ethical decisions, bought singly or as a package.
